description:
Experience ultimate speed and minimalist elegance with Nebula Launcher.

Nebula Launcher is built from the ground up for those who value simplicity, lightning-fast performance, and absolute privacy. By stripping away heavy background processes and forced tracking, Nebula delivers a beautiful, clutter-free home screen experience that keeps your phone running smoothly and saves your battery.

Purely Minimal. Completely AI-Free.
We believe your phone should serve you, not track you. Nebula Launcher includes absolutely zero AI predictive engines, zero data tracking, and zero background analytics. 100% of your data stays completely local on your device.

Key Features:

Ultra-Lightweight Performance: A tiny installation footprint and optimized code mean instant response times and zero phone bloat.

Beautiful Gradient Themes: Enjoy a stunning, modern look out of the box with fluid purple-to-teal design motifs.

Smart UI Contrast: App labels and interface text automatically adjust contrast to stay perfectly readable against your wallpaper.

Optimized App Drawer: Access your full app library instantly via a fast, fluid vertical scrolling grid with an intuitive top search bar.

Curated Customization: Toggle dark mode and select your favorite accent colors to personalize your setup without adding unnecessary system weight.

Recent Apps Dock: A dedicated, dynamically updating row keeps your top 5 most frequent apps exactly where you need them.

Ditch the bloated, cluttered launchers that track your habits. Download Nebula Launcher today for a clean, secure, and blazing-fast Android experience.

Study without cramming. Learn every time you unlock your phone.

InkDeck turns your physical study materials into smart, interactive flashcards delivered straight to your home screen. Stop spending hours manually typing out decks or trying to squeeze in long, boring study sessions. Just snap a photo of your handwritten notes, study guides, or worksheets, and let InkDeck do the heavy lifting.

📸 SNAP TO DECK
Instant OCR Extraction: Take a photo of your notes or textbooks, and InkDeck automatically parses terms, questions, and definitions into structured flashcard decks.

Diagram & Print Friendly: Works with both printed worksheets and handwritten study sheets.

📱 PASSIVE MICRO-LEARNING
Interactive Home Screen Widgets: Study directly from your home screen without even launching the app.

Tap to Reveal & Rate: Flip cards in-place with a single tap, then grade your retention with Got It or Review Again.

🧠 SMART SPACED REPETITION
Built for Maximum Retention: Cards you find difficult cycle back onto your widget more frequently, while mastered cards scale out naturally over days and weeks.

Zero Friction: Turn tiny pockets of downtime throughout your day—checking notifications or unlocking your phone—into active learning moments.

🎨 CLEAN & DISTRACTION-FREE
Built with a high-contrast dark theme and sleek electric purple accents designed for maximum readability on AMOLED displays.

No cluttered social feeds or unnecessary bloat—just pure, focused studying.

Download InkDeck today and start mastering your decks, one unlock at a time.
